text_block_list.text:
While working in the trainer's office,
Gold City came in looking exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I'll go once I've rested, so...
can't you just let me stay here a little longer?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I don't want anyone seeing me completely worn out.
I hate being worried over, and I hate being looked down on.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"I know I can't go on like this, but...
I just can't seem to get fired up... *sigh*."

She seems terribly exhausted. Could it be due to
having so many races in a row recently?
It might be best to review her race schedule.
